question: Can ex-ante risk scaling and selective participation turn the structural SPY variance premium into a more stable investable strategy?
verdict: RESULT C - ex-ante scaling/timing does not make unconditional variance carry investable

engine.reproduction: exact, zero difference on every trade

key_findings.premium_is_paid_for_the_risk_targeting_r: Mean development P&L rises monotonically across entry-variance quartiles ($76/$3,432/$3,697/$5,083) while dispersion rises nine-fold. Inverse-variance scaling halves top-quartile mean P&L.
key_findings.carry_signal_is_inverted_at_the_moment_i: Expected VRP peaked before both catastrophes. C3/F1/F2 held their 1.50 cap into 2020-03-02; C3 sits at the 0th percentile of 2000 random month selections.
key_findings.implied_variance_is_the_best_forecast: QLIKE 0.380 vs HAR 0.441 and EWMA 0.570, so expected VRP against any weaker forecast is mostly forecast error.
key_findings.every_edge_was_one_episode: No rule keeps a positive edge over its flat control once Feb-Mar 2020 is removed; D falls to -0.001.
key_findings.single_trade_dominance: Development: one trade -$732,061 against a ten-year total of +$368,604. OOS: April 2025 -$209,153 against a period total of +$12,064; the other 31 trades made +$221,217.
key_findings.no_specification_beats_luck: Expected maximum Sharpe under the null across 12 specifications is 0.263; the best observed is 0.386 with a deflated Sharpe probability of 0.61. Bootstrap intervals for mean trade P&L contain zero for every specification.
key_findings.puts_are_a_poor_hedge_for_path_risk: 0.90-moneyness puts cost $383,791 over 2013-2025 and returned $127,119, a drag of 67% of lifetime net P&L, while improving the worst trade only 11.5%. Variance is a path functional; a put pays on the terminal level, and SPY had recovered much of the March 2020 drawdown by the contract's expiry.
key_findings.surface_signals_carry_a_data_artifact: deep_down_share correlates -0.885 with put-wing width, so it partly measures OptionMetrics quote coverage.

tail_hedge_diagnostic.structure: 0.90 put and 0.90/0.80 put spread, spot-equivalent sizing
